Lemon Garlic Salmon with Rice
Serves 4

INGREDIENTS
☐ 4 salmon fillets (6 oz each)
☐ 2 tablespoons butter, melted
☐ 4 garlic cloves, minced
☐ juice of 1 lemon
☐ 1 cup (185 g) uncooked long grain white rice
☐ 2 cups water
☐ 1 pound asparagus, trimmed

INSTRUCTIONS
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Place the salmon fillets and asparagus on a sheet pan.
Step 2: Mix the melted butter, garlic and lemon juice and brush over the salmon fillets.
Step 3: Bake for 12-15 minutes.
Step 4: Meanwhile bring the rice and water to a boil, cover and simmer 18 minutes.
